summary_en: Correction to MBO support announcement. LLC VIC (subsidiary of Itochu Corporation) tender offer for all Dentsu Soken shares (excluding 120.78M held by Dentsu Group at 61.78% and issuer treasury). Tender price ¥2,880/share (on assumption of no December period dividend). Planned delisting and privatization. Final board approval of VIC offeror completed 31 Aug 2026.
title_en: Correction to Notice of Expression of Opinion and Recommendation to Participate Regarding Planned Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Shares by LLC VIC
translation_en_brief: This is a corrective filing (issued 31 August 2026) to an earlier MBO support and participation recommendation announcement dated 28 August 2026. The issuer, Dentsu Soken (TSE Prime, ticker 4812), had announced its support for a tender offer by LLC VIC, a subsidiary of Itochu Corporation, to acquire all outstanding shares of Dentsu Soken (excluding 120,779,736 shares representing 61.78% already held by parent Dentsu Group and issuer treasury shares). The tender price is fixed at ¥2,880 per share, premised on Dentsu Soken not paying a December-period final dividend in 2026. The transaction aims to delist the company and take it private, enabling agile mid-to-long-term decision-making and value creation by combining Dentsu Soken's consulting and application-development capabilities with Itochu Group's IT infrastructure, customer base, M&A experience and overseas networks. The correction reflects a delay in final board approval by Itochu Corporation (parent of the offeror): the original announcement stated approval was conditional on satisfaction of certain conditions that had not been met as of 28 August; the correction confirms that those conditions were satisfied and final approval was obtained on 31 August 2026. No material change to offer terms, price, or strategic rationale is disclosed in the correction.
